"""Original pose-and-finger controller for the frozen RoboCasa GR1 instance.

Run: python /app/output/gen.py
The controller reads object and hand poses, moves the right hand through smooth

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp
import casa_tool


def hand_pose(s, arm="right"):
    site = s.model.site(f"gripper0_{arm}_grip_site").id
    return s.data.site_xpos[site].copy(), s.data.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).copy()


def object_position(s, name="obj"):
    return s.data.xpos[s.env.obj_body_id[name]].copy()


def command(s, position, orientation, arm="right", fingers=None):
    action = s.targets.copy()
    base = s.model.body("robot0_base").id
    base_rotation = s.data.xmat[base].reshape(3, 3)
    base_position = s.data.xpos[base]
    start = 0 if arm == "right" else 6
    action[start:start + 3] = base_rotation.T @ (np.asarray(position) - base_position)
    action[start + 3:start + 6] = Rotation.from_matrix(base_rotation.T @ orientation).as_rotvec()
    if fingers is not None:
        action[12 + start:18 + start] = fingers
    return action


def move(s, position, orientation, steps, settle=10, fingers=None):
    initial_position, initial_orientation = hand_pose(s)
    rotations = Slerp([0, 1], Rotation.from_matrix([initial_orientation, orientation]))
    for i in range(steps):
